B1.name: Water Manipulation
B1.description: River utilizes water around and within herself, dealing [Water] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Spray water from her fists, dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Throws a sphere of water at opponents, dealing AoE damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Slashes with a surging wave, dealing % of attack as damage. Gain a stack of [Overwhelming Mana].

additional.text: {{effect:overwhelming-mana}}

S1.name: Bubble Barrier
S1.description: Form a large bubble barrier around River that protects herself and party members. The bubble appears for 10 seconds, and allies who stand within it will take no damage from opponents and heal for % of River’s health per second; however, they cannot damage opponents though Special Skill activation or Basic Skills (activated damage over time and off-field attacks that triggered before entry still function without interruption).

additional.text: If River is outside of the active barrier, increase her damage by +% during the barrier’s duration and passively heal the rest of the party by +% of her health per half-second.
After the barrier dissipates, gain a stack of [Overwhelming Mana].
{{effect:overwhelming-mana}}
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Mana Cost: 120 MP

S2.name: Water Ball
S2.description: River forms a giant vortex of water, forming into a sphere, that she launches towards her enemies, dealing [Water] damage.

additional.text: The water ball implodes on opponents and deals % of attack as small AoE damage.
Cooldown: 3 seconds
Mana Cost: 25 MP

S3.name: True Water Spirit Release
S3.description: River creates a spiritual field in which her attacks are enhanced, lasting 15 seconds. She will periodically produce "Spirit Song" stacks, up to 10, once per second (indicated in a special meter next to her). Each stack of [Overwhelming Mana] gained while in the field also gives a stack of "Spirit Song."

additional.text: Per stack produced, her field grows and the strength of her Special Skill damage is increased by +% per stack. At a max of 10 stacks, the next Special Skill damage dealt will increase damage by an additional +%, then removes all stacks.

The field will undergo an elemental change based on the absorbed elements from Technical Skill: A Fox’s Tale, where the active character gains +70% resistance to that element and [Water] element while in the field.
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Mana Cost: 160 MP

U1.name: Transformation
U1.description: Sprays a wide area of water on the field that slows the advance of opponents and aides with allies' movement, lasting 12 seconds. Opponents in the water get the debuff [Slowness] and allies and self get [Speed Up]. River’s movement speed will additionally increase by +% for each stack of [Overwhelming Mana] owned while on the field.

additional.text: River gains an aquatic state which will make her immune to non-elemental, [Fire], and [Wind] attacks, lasting the duration of the field effect. Her water attacks will absorb any incoming attack’s element, changing color, and return it as the same elemental attack in addition to her own. Multiple elements can be mixed and returned.
{{effect:slowness}}
{{effect:speed-up}}
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: A Fox's Tale
T1.description: River’s Special Skills can absorb incoming elemental attacks of opponents (this does not get rid of the incoming attack), converting to a different color.

additional.text: The absorbed elements will increase that element’s damage for allies and self by +20% for 10 seconds. Opponents hit by the water ball will have their resistance to absorbed elements be reduced by -20% for 10 seconds.
[Water] damage will increase automatically as that is River’s innate magical affinity.
These effects additionally increase by +1% per stack of [Overwhelming Mana]. Gain a stack of [Overwhelming Mana] when mixing at least two other elements at once (Cooldown: 3 seconds).
Resonance: No additional effects. Exclusive to River.

Dupes.description: Can obtain infinite stacks of [Overwhelming Mana] and each stack gained will heal self and allies for 5% of her max health. For every 5 stacks, increase crit rate and damage for self by +5% but increase mana consumption by +5%. When 50 stacks are gained, increase self’s damage of all skills by +50%.

additional.text: Gain a stack of [Overwhelming Mana] every 5 seconds (Unconditional). All effect conditions that depend on gaining a stack will trigger automatically when obtaining these passive stacks.

Using the Dash Skill will enable her to enter into a water transformed state called Aquia Mode, negating damage completely and moving quickly, creating a water trail behind her. Stamina will be continuously consumed. She will take +50% more damage from an attack with [Knockback], ending the state.
{{effect:overwhelming-mana}}
{{effect:knockback}}
When max MP to less than 5%, gain the effect [Mana Recovery].
{{effect:mana-recovery}}

When obtaining [Overwhelming Mana], gain two instances instead of one. Gaining a stack increases her and allies’ MP regen by +1%, up to +50%. Effect scales proportionally to the number of stacks she has and is infinite so long as she has a stack.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.

River’s Special Skill cooldowns are permanently decreased by 3 seconds. The Special Skill: Water Ball consumes a single instance of [Overwhelming Mana] which increases the size of the AoE to a larger field range and self gains +10% damage increase. The rate continues to increase incrementally when the skill is used repeatedly in short succession and resets when ending repeated skill use and having mana depleted.

[Overwhelming Mana] gain enhances even further, up to three stacks are gained instead of one. Each stack will increase River’s Basic Skill damage by +2%. Whenever one is consumed, heal 2% of max health and recover 17 MP for self and all allies.
